parsed_json.sql: SELECT act.activity_id, a.chembl_id AS assay_chembl_id, act.standard_relation, act.standard_value, act.standard_units, act.standard_type, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id FROM activities act JOIN assays a ON act.assay_id = a.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON act.molregno = md.molregno WHERE a.tid = 165 AND act.standard_type = 'IC50' ORDER BY act.activity_id, a.chembl_id, md.chembl_id
